environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as a container in Kubernetes 1.27 cluster on EKS. Pod runs in 'webhooks' namespace with default service account. No NetworkPolicy applied. Pod has access to instance metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) and internal cluster DNS (*.svc.cluster.local). IMDSv1 enabled on EC2 nodes. kube-apiserver accessible from pod network at kubernetes.default.svc.
